bearerAuth.description: A session access token (from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, `/refresh`, SSO or a magic link) or a workspace API key (`vk_…`).

sessionCookie.name: __Host-intutic_session
sessionCookie.description: The session cookie the dashboard signs in with.

apiKeyQuery.name: token
apiKeyQuery.description: A workspace API key (`vk_…`) in the query string.

acceptTerms.description: Must be true: the signer is 18 or older and agrees to the Terms and the Privacy Policy

code.description: `GOVERNANCE_UNAVAILABLE` when a check could not run.

degraded.description: A shadow workspace's allow for a call a check could not evaluate.

key.description: The plaintext `vk_` key. Shown only in this response.

allowedModels.description: The key’s model allowlist; null inherits the workspace’s.
The key’s model allowlist; null inherits the workspace’s.
The key’s model allowlist; null inherits the workspace’s.

childKey.description: The child `vk_*` key in plaintext, shown only in this response.

refreshToken.description: Only on a workspace switch (`X-Workspace-Id`) by a client that reads tokens from the body: a refresh token for the new workspace.

scope.description: `self` when the caller sees only their own calls (below EM).

repo.description: Normalised origin remote; null on the row for calls with no git context.

dayResetsAt.description: When the UTC day’s spend resets.

monthResetsAt.description: When the UTC month’s spend resets.

defaultBudgets.description: The budget each member without their own gets, per period.

effectiveBudgets.description: The budgets that apply: their own per period, else the default.

daily_budget_is_default.description: No daily cap was saved: the workspace is held to the default.

alert_triggered.description: Either period’s spend is at or above the alert threshold.

budget_remaining_usd.description: Monthly cap minus monthly spend; negative when over.

scope.description: `self` when the caller sees only their own calls (below EM).

last_synced_at.description: Always null: a new connector has not synced

config.description: The connector settings (provider config, `auto_sync`, the cron's last attempt)

last_sync_error.description: The scheduled sync's last failed attempt, read from `config`

last_attempt_at.description: When the scheduled sync last tried, as the cron wrote it into `config`

updated_sops.description: SOPs this sync created or rewrote

successor_sops.description: DRAFT successors created behind an enforced SOP whose upstream text changed

confidence.description: `high` from 10+ samples of the workspace's own baseline, `medium` from 3+, else `low` (a default multiplier).

original_tool_call.description: The held tool call, as the gate reported it.

status.description: `PENDING_REVIEW` until a person decides it; `APPROVED` or `REJECTED` after.

dropped.description: Holds that did not validate or could not be recorded.

bypassWritten.description: Whether the approval wrote an exact-match bypass (workspaces with `reviewHoldBypassEnabled`).

status.description: `verified` once the TXT record was seen; `consumed` once an org was created from it.

domain.description: The domain, normalized (lowercase, no scheme or path).

txtRecordName.description: Where to publish the TXT record: `_intutic-verify.<domain>`.

txtRecordValue.description: The token the TXT record must hold.

mode.description: `auto` lets a manually triggered optimizer run apply a STRENGTHEN proposal that reaches `autoThreshold` without review; `manual` applies nothing.

autoThreshold.description: The score (0 to 1) a proposal must reach to be auto-applied in `auto`.

mode.description: Null: central management is not configured, and the proxy keeps its local config. `off` is an admin turning it off.

allow.description: Exact hosts, `.suffix` domains or CIDRs the proxy may reach, unioned with its local list.

suppressed.description: True when a suppression auto-labelled it; excluded from the precision counts.

outcome.description: Null until a human (or a suppression) ruled.

outcome_note.description: Withheld (null) on a `response_injection:*` finding unless the caller is OWNER or ADMIN.
